mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger a flight to safety, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of months where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor market participation (PAYEMS) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances (i.e., when both series decline, SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (as indicated by rising FEDFUNDS), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to increased discount rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In periods classified as monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past 3 months signals strong aggregate demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of periods where RSAFS has increased for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 in a single month, it signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of months where INDPRO falls below 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a monetary tightening cycle coinciding with labor market weakness, which triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE fails to predict negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances (i.e., when both series rise, SPX returns are positive in >50% of cases).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion (as indicated by high housing starts), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to overvaluation and impending policy tightening.
failure_condition: In periods classified as late-cycle expansion (HOUST above 1800.0 for 3 consecutive months), the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.
